account.title: Akaunt
account.deleteHint: Ɛpopa wo CareMate data a ɛyɛ wo de na ɛma wo fi mu daa. Ɔyarehwɛ abakɔsɛm a ɛwɔ provider nkyɛn betumi atena sɛ wɔayi din no.
account.deleteConfirmMessage: Wo profile, emergency card, abusua nkitahodi, ne health tools bɛpopa koraa. Worentumi nkɔ so ntumi nkɔ mu bio. Nkrataa ne abakɔsɛm a ɛwɔ providers anaa insurers nkyɛn betumi atena sɛ Deleted user. Subscriptions a ɛreyɛ adwuma bɛtwa mu sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a.
account.deleteSuccessMessage: Wɔapopa wo CareMate data a ɛyɛ wo de. Wubetumi abɔ account foforo bere biara a wode email koro no bɛyɛ.
